readable.description: True only when the photo shows a market and at least one price or a clear chart scale.

instrument.description: Symbol or market name printed in the photo. Empty string if none is printed.

timeframe.description: Chart timeframe printed in the photo, such as 15m or 1D. Empty string if none is printed.

bias.description: buy means set a long. sell means set a short or exit. wait means place no new order.

timing.description: now: market order. wait_for_price: resting limit. after_close: wait for the bar to close. stay_out: place nothing.

confidence.description: How legible the photo is, not a chance of profit. Blurry or cropped photos stay at 40 or below.

headline.description: One sentence under 18 words. No exclamation marks and no profit promises.

when_to_act.description: One or two plain sentences naming the prices and what to do if price never gets there.

last_price.description: Last traded price printed in the photo. Empty string if you cannot read it.

price.description: Price to set the buy. Empty string if there is no buy.

why.description: One short sentence on why this buy price. Empty string if there is no buy.

price.description: Price to set the sell. Empty string if there is no sell.

why.description: One short sentence on why this sell price. Empty string if there is no sell.

price.description: Price where the idea is wrong and the position should be closed. Empty string if none.

why.description: One short sentence. Empty string if there is no stop.

invalid_if.description: What price action cancels the idea.

what_i_see.description: Up to 4 short facts visible in the photo.

risks.description: Up to 3 concrete ways this read can be wrong.

chart_levels.description: Lines to draw on the photo. Skip a level if you cannot place it.

y_percent.description: Vertical position in the full photo. 0 is the top edge. 100 is the bottom edge.
